:::{#def-bias-variance-tradeoff}
#### Bias--variance trade-off

The **bias--variance trade-off** is the pattern,
across models of increasing flexibility,
in which the squared bias of their predictions falls and the variance rises,
so that the [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error)
is smallest at an intermediate flexibility.
